summary: 周日 X 上出现一场“隐私是否已死”的讨论。gakonst 说他想的主要是隐私从此有多“死”；Vitalik 回应“只有放弃了才算死”，表示不会放弃隐私，而是加倍投入；pcaversaccio 认为隐私没死，只是默认设置做错了，隐私必须是运行时的一部分，而不是让用户自己配置。规范方面只有少量修订。

items.title: gakonst：他主要在想隐私从此以后有多“死”
items.title_en: gakonst: the main thing he thinks about is how dead privacy is from here on

items.title: Vitalik：只有放弃了才算死，我不会放弃隐私，而是加倍投入
items.title_en: Vitalik: it's only dead if you give up; I'm not giving up on privacy, I'm doubling down

items.title: pcaversaccio：隐私没死，只是默认设置做错了
items.note: 16:28，任何隐私都必须是运行时的一部分（执行层或浏览器等），而不是让用户配置，所以他多年来主张 L1 要发布隐私（帖子较长，此处只引用可见部分）。
items.title_en: pcaversaccio: privacy is not dead, we have just built the wrong defaults
items.note_en: 16:28; any privacy must be part of the runtime (an execution layer, a browser and so on) rather than something users configure, which is why he has argued for years that L1 must ship privacy (the post is long, and only the visible part is cited here).

items.title: Derek Chiang：用反事实思考隐私
items.note: 21:42，设想以太坊交易从第一天起就是私密的，而 2027 年一次升级把隐私拿走，社区会怎么反应。
items.title_en: Derek Chiang: thinking about privacy in counterfactuals
items.note_en: 21:42, imagining Ethereum transactions had been private from day one and a 2027 upgrade took privacy away, and asking how the community would react.

LefterisJP：为什么隐私重要

items.note_en: Binji's reflection on Vitalik's post, 04:37; LefterisJP: why privacy matters, 21:53.

summary_en: On Sunday a debate on whether privacy is dead broke out on X. gakonst said the main thing he thinks about is how dead privacy is from here on; Vitalik replied that "it's only dead if you give up", saying he is not giving up on privacy but doubling down; pcaversaccio argued privacy is not dead, we have just built the wrong defaults, and privacy must be part of the runtime rather than something users configure. Spec work was light.
